subject: Sleep Regularity Index isn't calculated anymore?

messages.author: bec33d17cd9adcc8
messages.subject: Sleep Regularity Index isn't calculated anymore?
parts:
Dear all

Does anyone have an idea why in the output of part 4 the following variables are empty?
SleepRegularityIndex
SriFractionValid
I used the same script (with the the same data) this Monday and got results, but today nothing seems to work (not even calling the basic function). I do not find any information on an argument specifying the calculation of SRI.

I used GGIR 2.9.0 in both cases.

Thanks in advance!
PJ

---
SCRIPT

# 1 - load GGIR
library(GGIR)

#
GGIR(# General settings
  datadir = "C:/Documents/SleepRItest",
  outputdir = "C:/Documents",
  mode = c(1:5),
  overwrite = TRUE,
  idloc=5,

  # Reports
  do.report = c(2,4,5),
  visualreport = TRUE,

  #data quality and metrics
  windowsizes=c(5,900,3600), 
 
  # part 1 - raw data processing
  do.enmo = TRUE,  
  do.anglez = TRUE, 
 
  # part 2 - data quality and descriptives
   strategy = 1,
 
  # select valid days
  includedaycrit=16, 
  includedaycrit.part5=0.667, 
 
  # Physical activity and acceleration distribution
  mvpathreshold = c(100.6), # Hildebrand 2016
 
  # part 3 & 4 - sleep detection and analysis
  HASIB.algo = "vanHees2015",
  HASPT.algo = "HDCZA",
  includenightcrit=16,
  loglocation = ("C:/Documents/SleepRI_dagboek.csv"),
  colid = 1,                         
  coln1 = 2,                         
  nnights = 7,
  sleeplogidnum = FALSE,             
  def.noc.sleep=c(1),                  
  sleeplogsep = ';',                 
  sleepwindowType = 'TimeInBed',     
  excludefirstlast = TRUE,
   
  # Part 5 - full-day time-use analysis
  threshold.lig=44.8,
  threshold.mod=100.6,
  threshold.vig= 428.8,
  timewindow = "MM")

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Sleep Regularity Index isn't calculated anymore?
parts:
Thanks PJ for reporting this. I had a look this morning and it relates to updates in R, which we somehow forgot to accommodate in the SRI calculation GGIR. I have prepared a fix and hopefully this can be part of the next GGIR release on GitHub (2.9-1) in the upcoming weeks.

In the mean time the code should still work with the previous version of R.

Vincent
